rationale: ioctl errno semantics are ground none of the 34 prior runs touched (they covered timers, epoll_ctl, SysV IPC perms, RLIMIT_NOFILE/FSIZE, S_ISGID, socket family dispatch, VFS permission checks). ioctl01 is 9 pure errno assertions on one syscall with no new subsystem behind it: EBADF on a closed fd, EFAULT on a bad/NULL termio(s) pointer, ENOTTY on an unknown cmd, and ENOTTY on a regular-file fd. Host is 9/9 pass on the pinned 20260529 prebuilt; Asterinas fails at my exact base_commit e8f2b9ca6 (probed this run, one boot). Two concrete leads found while shortlisting, both narrow and above any filesystem: (1) TCGETA (0x5405, the legacy struct termio interface) is absent from device/tty/ioctl_defs.rs, which defines only GetTermios TCGETS 0x5401 and GetTermios2 TCGETS2 - TCGETA is used by 4 of the 9 cases, and Linux implements it alongside TCGETS; (2) the ENOTTY-on-regular-file case rides on the default ioctl arm for InodeHandle (fs/file/inode_handle.rs:344), where the errno for a non-tty fd is the whole assertion. Both live in the ioctl dispatch layer that syscall/ioctl.rs fans out to, so one localized defect plausibly explains most of the failures. Preferred over the alternatives I probed or read: chdir01 and clock_gettime04 overlap already-diagnosed defects (statfs03's CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE-on-directories, clock_getres01's clockid dispatch), fcntl12 is open04's RLIMIT_NOFILE, open10/creat08/creat09 are mkdir02's S_ISGID inheritance, fdatasync02 is fsync03's, socketpair01 is socket01's (its diagnosis names socketpair.rs:51), and getcpu01/semop01 sit next to setpriority02 and the two semget/semctl IPC-stub runs. Ruled out as missing-feature risk rather than bug: mincore, mlock/mlockall/munlock, splice, tee, clock_settime, remap_file_pages and vhangup are all absent from both syscall dispatch tables; pipe2_01/pipe2_04/epoll_wait06 need pipe packet mode (TODO at fs/pipe/common.rs:163) or F_SETPIPE_SZ, neither of which exists; sched_getattr01 needs SCHED_DEADLINE; epoll_wait05 needs EPOLLRDHUP, which has no definition in the tree, and it came back broken not merely failing.
notes: Verify configuration is the default: entry comes from all.txt (line 591, '# ioctl01'), so no CONFORMANCE_TEST_WORKDIR override and run_vars is empty. Measured this run and written to select.cache: host pass for ioctl01, waitpid01, clock_gettime04, getcpu01, semop01, epoll_wait05, chdir01, fcntl17; host tbroke for openat02 (openat02.c:132 TBROK execlp() failed) and creat07, which removes both from candidacy without an Asterinas run. One boot at e8f2b9ca6 probed ioctl01, getcpu01, semop01, chdir01 (all fail) plus clock_gettime04, waitpid01 (fail) and epoll_wait05 (broken). No stale-entry records: nothing in the shortlist passed in Asterinas. ioctl01 needs a pty from openpty(), so devpts must be working for setup to reach the assertions; it did reach them (result was fail, not broken). The runner reports only per-test verdicts in qemu.log - KIRK_VERBOSE=1 is honored by run_ltp_test.sh but is not wired through the Makefile's kcmd-args, so diagnose will need another route for per-case TPASS/TFAIL lines.
